starting_state: Fresh 2 mL clear saturated sodium-bicarbonate solution before the source's chosen liquid-compound alternative is introduced.
scope: Sample delivery and possible initial effervescence only. Positive acid identity requires review; no pH, gas quantity or complete conversion is inferred.

clips.name: sample_delivery
clips.action: Deliver a few drops of the selected liquid compound into the existing sodium-bicarbonate solution with the tip above rim, then stop.
clips.state_before: Clear saturated sodium-bicarbonate solution in one fresh tube, no sample added yet.
clips.state_after: For a source-responsive acidic sample, CO2 effervescence begins in the existing tube. Preserve headspace; no new vessel, opaque white bulk liquid or overflowing foam.

reuse_rationale: Same visible pre-addition state: 2 mL clear colourless aqueous solution, one tube and ample headspace. Sodium-bicarbonate identity is specified separately, not inferred from pixels. This is a fresh independent sample, not the phenol or DNP aliquot.
